content.title: Book Recommendations
content.body:
A collection of recommended books with brief descriptions and personal notes.

## The Road - Book Recommendation

The Road by Cormac McCarthy features powerful post-apocalyptic storytelling with sparse but beautiful writing.

**Notes:** A father and son journey through a devastated America in this Pulitzer Prize-winning novel.

**Tags:** #books #post-apocalyptic #literary-fiction #recommendation

## Pachinko - Book Recommendation

Pachinko by Min Jin Lee is a captivating multi-generational Korean family saga set in Japan.

**Notes:** Epic historical novel that follows four generations of a Korean immigrant family in Japan.

**Tags:** #books #historical-fiction #family-saga #recommendation

**Related Recommendations:**
- [The Road Book Recommendation](#the-road---book-recommendation)
- [Dune Book Recommendation](#dune---book-recommendation)

---

## Dune - Book Recommendation

Dune by Frank Herbert features incredible worldbuilding and lives up to its status as a classic science fiction novel.

**Notes:** Set in a distant future amid a feudal interstellar society, Dune tells the story of young Paul Atreides as he and his family accept control of the desert planet Arrakis.

**Tags:** #books #science-fiction #worldbuilding #recommendation
